text:
amanda: Deploybot just flagged libfastjson (CVE-2024-9999) in RC-27 staging. severity: Medium. EU canary scheduled tonight within change window (ends 02:00 UTC). Do we carve out for minor vuln or hold the rollout?

deploy-bot: [auto] vulnerability scan result for artifact: release-rc27
- finding: libfastjson 1.2.3 -> CVE-2024-9999 (medium)
- path: /app/vendor/libfastjson
- SBOM: https://sbom.internal/release-rc27
- evidence: no public exploit listed
- recommended action: triage within 24h or hold rollout

sahil: given the change window we should avoid full hold. proposal: timeboxed EU carveout + strict rollback rules. start at 5% traffic -> 25% after 30m -> 100% after 2h if metrics stable. rollback if errors >1% OR latency p95 > 2x baseline.

cristina: can we pin to 1.2.4 (patched) in the manifest and do a hotpatch for rc-27? patch build will take ~45m. if patch is ready before cutoff, prefer patch+deploy.

security: we don't have exploitability evidence right now. low/no PoC. Accept timeboxed carveout only if: explicit monitoring, shortened canary steps, and a 6h evidence window where we keep artifact pinned and don't roll forward beyond EU region.

legal: any compliance/regulatory impact for EU customers? this is a library-level vuln, not data-exfiltration. no immediate legal blocker, but record decision in release notes.

qa: staging tests passed except one flaky integration that spiked yesterday (flaky-db-conn). not related to libfastjson AFAICT. can re-run full regression on patched build.

josh: +1 to timeboxed carveout. also update release notes with: "Minor dependency vulnerability flagged; monitored canary in EU. See ENG-4123 for decision."

amanda: quick decision then: if cristina can produce patched image (pin 1.2.4) before 01:15 UTC, we'll prefer hotpatch and standard rollout. if not, we do a timeboxed EU carveout: 5% -> 25% -> 100% with auto-rollback triggers (errors>1% or p95>2x). evidence window = 6h for post-canary investigation. assign tasks: cristina -> pin/patch, sahil -> configure rollout and alarms, security -> monitor and escalate, josh -> update release notes and ENG ticket. I'll post the carveout flag to deploybot in 5m if no patch. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

cristina: I can try for a patch. starting build now. ETA ~30-40m.

deploy-bot: received action: carveout-request queued by amanda at 1777770060

security: will stand by and watch telemetry. sending a short check script to prod-monitoring channel.

qa: re-running regression on patched branch now. will report in ~25m.

sahil: rollout config snippet I'll apply if we carveout:
```
rollout:
  region: eu
  steps: [5, 25, 100]
  step_delay_minutes: [15, 45, 120]
  rollback_conditions:
    - error_rate_pct > 1
    - p95_latency > baseline*2
```

josh: noted. ENG-4123 updated with decision tree and will include the final audit note.

amanda: final call at 01:10 UTC. if patch ready -> patch + standard rollout. else -> timeboxed carveout with the above config and 6h evidence window. tagging on-call for visibility. :eyes: 

legal: leaving thread but documented.

qa: patched branch regression passed (all green). patch looks good.

cristina: patched image pushed: docker.pkg.internal/release-rc27:patched-1.2.4 (sha256:abc123). pin applied to manifest.

amanda: beautiful — cancel carveout. proceed with patched build and normal canary. sahil, please run standard canary and keep the rollback alarms active for 6h post-rollout.

sahil: Will do. enabling alarms and 6h post-rollout watch. starting canary now at 5%.

deploy-bot: canary started: release-rc27 patched-1.2.4 -> 5% EU at 1777770300

josh: :thumbsup: updating release notes to mention patched dependency and quick summary of the triage.

security: monitoring shows no unusual signals in the first 20m. continuing watch. :mag:

amanda: thanks all — closing thread once canary reaches 100% and 6h evidence window completes.

(END)
